explanation: States that no term of the base-3 Reverse-and-Add trajectory of 103 is a base-3 palindrome. The recursion a(n+1) = a(n) + rev₃(a(n)) and the palindrome predicate are correct, and the statement captures the OEIS claim that the trajectory of 103 never reaches a palindrome. (The part "103 is the smallest such number" is not formalized; that is a separate claim.) The statement is faithful and tagged open.
